title: Hanasato Minori — Sharing My Honest Feelings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Cafeteria

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Let's see... #LuminaGrandPrix...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, people have posted so much stuff...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (A lot of them have written about us. Not only that...)
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're back, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for saving our seats for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you guys for bringing me a drink.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And here's your iced tea, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, what were you looking at just now...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You were grinning while staring at your phone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! Was I grinning that much?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I was just looking at the things people have posted about the grand prix...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The things people have posted...? Oh, about Lumina Time?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You did do incredibly well during the talk show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, Minori, I know you're happy, but you haven't forgotten that there are cameras in the room, have you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They're gonna catch you with your head in the clouds.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I forgot...!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, I'd be happy as well. It's always wonderful to see people enjoy something you worked so hard at.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's one thing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm also really glad that so many people are showing their support for Hikarin.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For Hikarin?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, take a look!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Playing the character you do while having such deep beliefs makes you the best, Hikarin!>
<My impression of you has changed for the better after hearing about your past.>
<I'm rooting for you, Hikarin! Keep dazzling us!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, this many...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A lot of them seem to like her even more now after hearing about her past.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure it took no small amount of courage on her part to talk about her past self...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm also happy that so many people are saying that they understand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly! I love Hikarin even more now, so I want lots and lots more people to start supporting her!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, have you forgotten that she's our rival?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know. But I'm hoping to get to know her better since she seems like a great friend to have as we work on this program.
se_run_women_002_1
Wh-Wh-Wh-Whoosh!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
This shooting star will grant your wish!
Hikarin, the galactic idol, has arrived☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wah?! H-Hikarin?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What a coincidence...!
We were just talking about you!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Heehee. My sensors reach all the way across the universe!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She probably just saw us on the stream, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: You said you wanted to talk to me, right, Minorin? I wanna talk to you too!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Also, I wanna cause a big bang with everyone else in MMJ☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're acting like we're about to start another universe... But I'm guessing it's your way of saying that you wanna talk to us, right?
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Idol A
rows.Line: Oh, I was wondering why the cafeteria sounded so lively... Minorin and Hikarin are doing stuff together again.

rows.Speaker: Idol B
rows.Line: Wait, all of MMJ is here!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Oh no! Our gravity is so strong that more and more people are being pulled towards us!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: This means we have no choice but to bang-zoom-boom together!

rows.Speaker: Idol A
rows.Line: B-Boom? Like an explosion?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, not an explosion!
She's saying that we should all have a fun conversation together! It's perfectly safe!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Thanks, Minorin! You know me so well☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd love to talk to you too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After hearing about everyone's goals and beliefs during Lumina Time, I want to get to know more and more about the other idols here!

rows.Speaker: Idol B
rows.Line:
In that case, I'm game!
I also wanna learn more about you guys!

rows.Speaker: Idol A
rows.Line: Me too. Actually, this might be a great opportunity since we have Hanasato here as Hikarin's interpreter.

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Oh, Minorin, that makes you the ambassador to Planet Twinkle!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! I-I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Something fun's starting!>
<A surprise collab chitchat stream?!>
<Wow, I can't wait to hear what this bunch has to say!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These comments are coming in so fast...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I don't think any of us were expecting things to unfold quite like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Props to Minori for creating a nice flow.
She did a really good job of getting everyone else involved.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, we can learn a lot from her example.
